subject: history
concept: Understanding that ancient civilizations eventually declined or changed, and considering why
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts possible-cause cards (war, drought, disease, changing trade) that could contribute to a civilization's decline
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described historical change to a plausible contributing factor
exercise.abstract: Student explains one possible reason a studied ancient civilization changed or declined over time

misconception_flags: assumes ancient civilizations vanished suddenly for a single simple reason, rather than considering multiple contributing factors

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
